title: Honey Glazed Peppery Macaroni Pasta
description: A silky and peppery Jamaican dish featuring macaroni, roasted vegetables, sugar-free-friendly. Perfect for a sick-day meal.
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain and set aside.
Prepare vegetables by chopping peppers, onions, carrots, and zucchini into bite-sized pieces.
In a large skillet, sauté garlic in olive oil until fragrant.
Add chopped vegetables to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes or until they start to soften.
Stir in salt, pepper, honey, and sugar-free sweetener (if using).
Pour vegetable broth into the skillet with vegetables. Bring mixture to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Fold cooked macaroni into vegetable mixture and stir well to combine.
Transfer the dish to an oven-safe baking dish and bake for 20-25 minutes or until cheese is golden brown and bubbly.
Serve hot as a hearty dinner.
